cabFrontOffset.note: Raster dimension; excludes roof gutter and frame thickness.

tyreDiameter.note: Working diameter is approximate, not unloaded tyre envelope.

railHeight.endpoints: ground to top of trolley rail; tentative raster reading
railHeight.note: Last digits and exact arrow termination require original JL28600. Not an established exact dimension.

totalHeightRead.note: Approximate TOTAL HEIGHT annotation is not unambiguously legible; do not use as exact input.

cabWidth.note: Text gives 2 m; other shape dimensions estimated from M14 p21,34.

headblockRopeSpan.endpoints: outer headblock rope attachment centres along Z
headblockRopeSpan.note: 5380 raster read; exact pin geometry unavailable.

headblockFrameSpan.endpoints: headblock end-frame reference lines along Z

wheelSprocketPitchDiameter.note: Derived from pitch 50.80 mm and 58 teeth; tooth form not modelled.

driveSprocketPitchDiameter.note: Derived from pitch 50.80 mm and 17 teeth; tooth form not modelled.

structure.note: Counts and topology verified; member profiles and connection thicknesses scaled estimates. M13 p71,246-249 corroborate shape.

gantry.note: Four driven outer wheels per project p17/23. Equalizer, carrier, bearing, steering, chain and guards simplified from eight-wheel views.

trolley.note: Arrangement + direct double wheel drive; dimensions not explicitly in the dimension table are visual estimates. M13 p72 repeats this drawing.

hoist.note: One motor/reducer/drum, two brakes; shapes estimated. Eight groove GROUPS from p16 override generic four-group prose; pitch unavailable.

ropes.note: Eight routes, twelve trolley sheaves, four paired edge terminations. Exact sheave-axis coordinates and drum departure tangencies unresolved; schematic paths.

spreader.note: Separate headblock and electric telescopic spreader. Retracted visual envelope only; no supplier manufacturing dimensions. Cylinders/turnbuckles are qualified simplified forms.

cabin.figure: Fig 2-35; JL2860606 listed p21; M13 p11
cabin.note: Cab follows trolley. Angled lower glazing, door, support, seat and two consoles. Shape/offset except stated approximate height and width estimated.

electrical.note: E-room above sill. Cabinet identities and exact placement unavailable; qualified area markers only.

power.note: Diesel plus lithium battery verified. Power-room envelope estimated from GA. Vendor internals and battery mounting not established; area markers only.

chain.note: Project IGUS 5050RHD.30.300.0. Exact guide, bend radius and fixed-end geometry unavailable; dynamic path illustrative.

access.note: Access route follows stair-side silhouette. Flight rise/run, tread count, rails and landing dimensions estimated; original JL28604 required.

lights.note: Trolley floodlight shown; exact fitting shape/other crane lighting locations unavailable.

frameDetail.note: Girders, rails, buffers, tapered legs, brace bar and sill beam with end lugs. The buffer support doubles as the lifting ear. Rail fixing by clips or welding; clip pitch, joint plates and gussets estimated.

bogieDetail.figure: Fig 2-5 / 2-6 eight-wheel drive and idle bogies; p23
bogieDetail.note: Labelled lock-pin cylinder, equalizer, drive device, slewing bearing, small/large sprockets, driven/driving wheels, guard, steering cylinder, anti-collision switch, link rod and protective frame. Shapes and offsets scaled estimates.

gantryChain.note: Double-strand bush roller chain 160SW pitch 50.80 mm, ratio 58/17. Sprocket pitch circles derived; tooth form, chain path and guard plates simplified.

hoistDrive.figure: Fig 2-10 hoist driving mechanism; p26 switches
hoistDrive.note: Motor, high-speed coupling, reducer with oil indicator/breather, two high-speed brakes, drum coupling and bearing seat. Motor encoder plus overspeed and cam limit switches on the drum shaft end (p26). Casings estimated.

trolleyItems.figure: JL28606 item list (items 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13); p38 anchor/guide/buffer text
trolleyItems.note: Over-height limit, trolley anchor devices (two per p38), side rollers, centralized lubrication, spreader cable reel and trolley connect box are listed; their exact shapes and mounting points are estimated.

gaItems.note: Name plate arrangement, limit switch assembly, hydraulic station and GPS/RCMS support are listed on the general arrangement; positions read approximately from the views, fittings estimated.

safety.note: Wind speed indicator, anti-collision device on four corners, lighting and signal apparatus and gantry-travel alarm are stated. Device models and mounting positions are not given; locations estimated.

eroom.note: E-room on sill with platform/guard rail and two air conditionings; leg-mounted lamp visible. Stainless steel chain guide and L bracket with floating connection. Dimensions estimated from photographs.

jacking.figure: section 8.1-8.2 gantry traveling; M14 p66 tyre inspection; user statement 4 November 2026
jacking.note: Each tyred wheel is rotated about its centre by 16° and 90° under non-operational conditions (M13 p19), and turning tyres without the jack-up device wears them (M14 p66). The user confirmed four jacks per RTG for turning. Site photos WA-23/24/26 (5 November 2026) show one jack centred under each equalizer between the tyres, with a square sleeve, red barrel, chrome rod and ribbed swivel foot. No jack drawing, rating or stroke was supplied; proportions are scaled from the photos.

reeving.figure: Fig 2-14 8 ropes reeving; p26 text; JL28606 front/side views p21
reeving.note: Topology from the text and Fig 2-14: ropes clamped on the drum, 12 trolley sheaves (8 fall + 4 horizontal guides), pairs joined through turnbuckles at the four headblock edge midpoints as four isosceles triangles. Fall planes and positions read from the trolley views; groove assignment, sheave shaft coordinates and diameters are estimates. Top/bottom drum leads follow from all ropes winding in together.

exhaust.figure: section 2.1.2 diesel generator set; user statement 5 November 2026
exhaust.note: Diesel power room per M14. The user stated that the exhaust line is connected to the RTG leg and goes up to the top. Pipe size, clamp spacing, the leg face used and the exit height are estimated; the photos do not show the run clearly.

sitePhotos.note: Twenty-eight photographs of a CICT ZP12-1874 RTG. Used for shapes, positions and finishes the manuals do not give: turning jacks, drive platforms, trolley drives and cabinet, cable basket, chain portal, lamps and pipework. Scaled against known dimensions; perspective limits accuracy.

cabInterior.figure: Cab interior photographs WA-02 / WA-03, 5 November 2026; M14 p34 Fig 2-35
cabInterior.note: Seat with two armrest consoles (joystick, push-button grid, emergency stop), stainless HMI touchscreen cabinet, CCTV monitor, lower-window bar grille and blinds. M14 p34 confirms seat, paired consoles and AC. Positions and sizes scaled from wide-angle photos.

nameplate.note: ZPMC plate: RC40.5t, ZP12-1874, licence TS2410724-2014, span 23.47 m, wheelbase 7.9 m, lift 21.2 m, max wheel load < 41 t, wheels 8/4 driven, CAT C7, generator TYFZ18000-280L-G, group class U8/Q3/A8, skew ±5°.

busbar.figure: User site photographs; Table 2-1 supply types
busbar.note: Photographs show a DZD-230 self-connecting busbar power collector fitted to the crane. M14 Table 2-1 lists low-voltage contact-bus supply as a type, while the original project option was diesel generator + lithium battery. Retrofit status, side and geometry are photo-estimated.
